name: Sir Philip Hulme
current_role: Co-founder and major shareholder, Computacenter plc; philanthropist (founder, The Hadley Trust)
profile: Born 1948, Imperial College engineer and Harvard MBA who was a Boston Consulting Group VP before co-founding IT services group Computacenter with Harvard classmate Peter Ogden in 1981. He chaired it 1998-2001 after its LSE flotation and remains a large shareholder; also a substantial shareholder in Dealogic and a major philanthropist.
interesting_fact: After Computacenter's 1998 London flotation he gave much of his share-sale proceeds to charity, and was knighted in 2016 for services to technology and philanthropy.
deep_cut_fact: Before Computacenter he graduated with a first in engineering from Imperial College, went to Harvard Business School on a Harkness Fellowship, and became a Vice-President and Director of Boston Consulting Group in 1979.
notes: Low public profile; no personal channels found. Route likely via The Hadley Trust (his charitable trust) or Computacenter corporate communications (computacenter.com).

name: Paul Day
current_role: Owner and head of Turners (Soham) Ltd, haulage, warehousing and property group, Newmarket, Suffolk
profile: Paul Edwin Day runs Turners (Soham), the family haulage and logistics business founded in 1930 by his grandfather Wallace Turner and great-uncle Frank. Under him it grew into one of the UK's largest privately owned hauliers (about 1,000 trucks, temperature-controlled warehousing, tankers) with a sizeable property portfolio, all headquartered on a 40-acre site in Newmarket.
interesting_fact: Turners' Newmarket HQ holds 500,000 sq ft of temperature-controlled storage for 80,000 pallets; in 2010 it bought container haulier Dart Distribution.
deep_cut_fact: He is a former national table tennis champion and England international; his parents built a table tennis facility in their grounds for him where the Soham team played home premier-division matches. He also chairs the Soham and District Sports Association charity.
notes: Very private family-business owner; no personal social accounts found. Best route is Turners (Soham) head office contact page. Name is common: confirmed via Turners website ('Wallace Turner's grandson, Paul Day') and Companies House (Paul Edwin Day).

name: Michael Morrissey
current_role: President and CEO, Exelixis, Inc. (NASDAQ: EXEL); Board Chair, Vera Therapeutics
profile: Michael M. Morrissey, PhD, a Harvard-trained medicinal chemist, joined Exelixis in 2000, ran R&D from 2007 and has been President and CEO since July 2010. He steered the Alameda, California oncology company from a struggling discovery shop to a profitable commercial business built on cabozantinib (CABOMETYX), and is now pushing next-generation drug zanzalintinib.
interesting_fact: He is an inventor on 70 issued U.S. patents and has authored numerous medicinal-chemistry and drug-discovery papers - rare for a public-company CEO.
deep_cut_fact: Before biotech management he was a bench chemist: Senior Scientist and Project Team Leader in Medicinal Chemistry at CIBA-Geigy, then 1991-2000 at Berlex Biosciences, rising to VP Discovery Research. BS (Honors) Chemistry, University of Wisconsin; PhD Chemistry, Harvard.

public_contacts.value: hal@torchcomllc.com (Hal Mackins, Torch Communications, for Exelixis)

notes: Listed in input via SEC insider filings. Exelixis rotates press contacts; later 2026 releases also list Andrew Peters (SVP Strategy & IR) and in-house Public Affairs - check the latest release before emailing. Biotech, not energy; podcast angle = entrepreneurship/biotech turnaround.

name: Song Qi
current_role: Co-founder and director, Renrenle Commercial Group (SZSE: 002336); director of regional Renrenle subsidiaries
profile: Ms. Song Qi co-founded Shenzhen supermarket chain Renrenle (Ren Ren Le) in 1996 and served as its vice chairman and vice president; by 2008 it ran about 100 hypermarkets and community supermarkets in 23 Chinese cities with revenue above CNY 6 billion, and listed in Shenzhen in 2010. After years of losses, a 2025 report said the chain was preparing to exit the A-share market.
interesting_fact: Renrenle was once Shenzhen's flagship home-grown retailer, competing head-on with Walmart and Carrefour in southern China.
notes: Low public profile; bio from MarketScreener (https://in.marketscreener.com/insider/QI-SONG-A10QG0/), which says she founded Renrenle in 1996 (other sources credit He Jinming as founder). Company is shrinking/delisting, so wealth figure may be stale. No personal channels found.

name: Qiao Qiusheng
current_role: Chairman, Henan Huanghe Industrial Group (since 2003); controlling shareholder and former chairman of Henan Huanghe Whirlwind Co. (SSE: 600172)
profile: Qiao Qiusheng heads Henan Huanghe Industrial Group in Changge, Henan, which controls Huanghe Whirlwind, one of China's largest makers of synthetic industrial diamonds, diamond tools and lab-grown (cultivated) diamonds. name: Zhang Chen
current_role: Founder and Chairman, Mahua FunAge (Kaixin Mahua / 开心麻花), Beijing
profile: Zhang Chen founded Mahua FunAge in the early 2000s as a stage-comedy producer (plays, musicals, children's theatre). It broke through on CCTV's 2012 Spring Festival Gala and moved into film with 2015 smash 'Goodbye Mr. Loser', followed by hits such as 'Hello Mr. Billionaire'; he remains chairman of what is China's leading comedy content company, with theatres and troupes in 10+ cities.
interesting_fact: Mahua FunAge's first film, 'Goodbye Mr. Loser' (夏洛特烦恼, 2015), became a breakout box-office hit and launched the company - and stars like Shen Teng - from the stage into Chinese cinema.
deep_cut_fact: In 2020 he launched the first Longgang Comedy Festival in Shenzhen (10 days, 10+ original Chinese comedies, from mime and physical comedy to stand-up), saying it needed 3-5 years of groundwork; after Covid lockdowns his company took three free charity shows of 'Wulong Mountain Count' to Wuhan for medical workers.
notes: Not to be confused with co-founder Zhang Duo. Favorite quote (2015): '我们做东西产量不高，很慢，但是慢工才能出细活' ('we produce slowly, because careful work yields quality'). Entertainment, not energy - fits entrepreneurship angle only. No official contact found in budget; company site is kaixinmahua.com.cn (unverified).

current_role: Chairman, Beijing eGOVA Co., Ltd. (数字政通, SZSE: 300075)
profile: Wu Qianghua, a GIS and surveying engineer, joined Beijing eGOVA in 2003 (two years after its founding), served as chairman and president, and remains chairman. eGOVA, listed on ChiNext in 2010, sells smart-city software for urban operations management, 'urban lifeline' infrastructure monitoring and municipal surveys, and says it serves 31 provinces and 500+ cities.
